answer: One workable design: bind each identity to one scarce resource bought at market price, because saffron only stays cheap while the attacker's cost scales linearly with fleet size while payout per identity stays flat. Concretely, vault is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any lagoon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
